name: Roland JC-120 Jazz Chorus (1982)
description: The 1982 JC-120 as drawn (Roland JC-120 '82 sheet; JC-120/JC-160 Service Notes 5th ed., S/N 258100+): the effect channel CH-2 (2SK117 input stage, FMV tone stack, JFET distortion with its feedback clipper, bright/volume, Q5 and the Q16/Q15 feedback pair), Z-3F spring reverb with its push-pull current drive, the MN3007/MN3101 chorus-vibrato with the IC5 LFO, the JFET dry/wet switches and the channel-mix matrix, CH-1's output stage (its volume at 0), both discrete 60 W power amplifiers into one 12-inch speaker each, and the +-37 V bridge supply with its +30 / +15 / +26 / +12.5 V regulators. Left = CH-1 amp (dry), right = CH-2 amp (dry, or the BBD signal in Chorus/Vibrato).

sources.title: Roland JC-120 1982 circuit diagram ('Roland JC 120' 82', 2543x1982), music-electronics-forum thread 4690

Roland JC-120/JC-120A/JC-160 Service Notes, 4th edition (S/N 789500-248099), specifications (22 V RMS into 8 ohm per channel)

2SK117GR.note: Toshiba 2SK117-GR: GR-rank IDSS 2.6-6.5 mA, VGS(off) -0.2 to -1.5 V; card takes IDSS 4.5 mA, Vp -0.7 V (BETA = IDSS/Vp^2), Ciss 13 pF / Crss 3 pF. Mid-rank (A). Reproduces the drawn Q1 drain +12.4 V and Q3 drain +10.4 V within 0.1 V

2SK246GR.note: Toshiba 2SK246-GR switching JFET: IDSS 2.6-6.5 mA, VGS(off) -0.7 to -6.0 V; card IDSS 4.5 mA, Vp -1.5 V, Rds(on) ~170 ohm. Mid-rank (A)

2SA970GR.note: Toshiba 2SA970-GR low-noise PNP, hFE 200-400; generic EM values (A)

2SC2240GR.note: Toshiba 2SC2240-GR low-noise NPN, hFE 200-400; generic EM values (A)

2SC2229.note: Toshiba 2SC2229 150 V voltage-amplifier NPN, hFE 70-240; generic EM values (A)

2SD669.note: Hitachi 2SD669A-C driver NPN, hFE C 100-200; generic medium-power EM values (A)

2SB649.note: Hitachi 2SB649A-C driver PNP, hFE C 100-200; generic medium-power EM values (A)

2SD845.note: NEC 2SD845 (or 2SC3182/2SC2773/2SC2564) output NPN; generic power EM values (A); IS sets the idle current with the spreader (notes 6.3)

2SD667.note: Hitachi 2SD667-C NPN (reverb driver, +30 V pass); generic EM values (A)

2SB647.note: Hitachi 2SB647-C PNP reverb driver; generic EM values (A)

2SD313E.note: 2SD313-E TO-220 +15 V pass NPN, hFE E 100-200; generic EM values (A)

2SC667.note: 2SC667-C CH-1 +30 V pass NPN; generic EM values (A)

1S2473.note: Hitachi 1S2473 switching diode: the library 1N914 card (as the HM-2)

RD16EB2.note: NEC RD16E-B2 500 mW zener; bv FITTED so the +15 V rail reads the drawn 15 V at the drawn loads (Vz 15.9 V at ~3 mA is inside the RD16E B-ranks); Zzt ~ nbv*Vt/I (A)

RD30EB4.note: NEC RD30E-B4 500 mW zener; bv FITTED so the two +30 V rails read the drawn 30 V (A)

NJM4558.note: NJM4558DD (IC1, IC2, IC5): the library JRC4558 card (Av 100 dB, GBW 3 MHz, SR 1 V/us), rails from the supply pins (0/+30 V, 0/+15 V)

MN3007_JC.note: the library MN3007 card with its -11 / -4.6 V window referred to this circuit's VSS = +15 V (pin 1) and VDD = 0 V (pin 5): window 4.0-10.4 V around the 7.5 V input bias set by IC2 / R126-R127

Z3F.note: Roland Z-3F reverb unit (parts list p.4): no published data; short two-spring tank FITTED (8 ohm in, 2575 ohm out, flight 16.5/19.8 ms, T60 2.0 s) as in v2

NJM4558_15.note: NJM4558DD on the regulated +15 V rail (IC2, IC5): the library JRC4558 card with fixed rails 1.5 / 13.83 V (+15 V rail measured 15.33 V, 7 uV ripple). Fixed rails because the rail-node form on this supply-cut rail storms under LTE substeps (notes session 7)

NJM4558_30.note: NJM4558DD on the regulated +30 V rail (IC1): fixed rails 1.5 / 28.62 V (+30 V rail 30.12 V)

R118 47K to the LINE OUT node. A load of the lineout cut with R49_1 (docs/CIRCUIT_ENGINE.md §10.33): the 100 R LINE OUT divider is fed only through the two 47k resistors, so it is its own group and the two power amps no longer read each other within a sample (intra-unit lanes). Against R118_2 in the right amp's group (autocut --try, unit path, lead DI): DI null -153.3 dB rms / -137.6 dB peak, sine -152.8, dimed -154.0 dB.
